html:
Death Squared is a cooperative puzzle game for 1, 2 or 4 players, best enjoyed with loved ones who don't mind a little arguing for the greater good. It's quick to pick up and play and one of the few co-op puzzle games where anyone, young and old, can play. No fast reflexes required, just a sharp mind and determination!

Prove your teamwork skills in Death Squared as you solve puzzles together or die trying! Each player needs to guide a robot to a colour-coded goal, but the path to your goal is beset with deadly traps and hazards. Teams of players will need close observation and communication to keep each other alive and discover a solution together.

Complete the main campaign with one or two players, observed and "encouraged" by the dry wit of hapless testing technician David and his artificial assistant Iris. Then take a group into four-player Party Mode for the ultimate teamwork trial! For those that can't get enough, head to the 'Vault' to find extra experiments recommended only for the brave.

Features:
 

  • Every level is a micro-journey of: surprise > discovery > mastery > success
  • 80 puzzling levels in the Story mode
  • 40 Party levels designed for 4 Players
  • 45 Vault Levels (22 for 2 Players, 23 for 4 Players) - tougher challenges for the dedicated player!
  • Hats and decals to decorate your bots
  • Color-blind mode
  • Extra difficulty modifiers for those who laugh in the face of danger, and bombs
